missionPremise: OPS-16 amendments A-018/A-019. P-43 delivered two counties of 253 (SS-W5). The operator's L26 screenshots corrected the planner: the audit is THREE layers (WRITTEN atoms / SCORED ledger cells / SERVED sheet), not two, and all three disagree independently. The divergences ARE the defect list, and the ordering decides what remediation costs: written-unscored is a scorer run, written-unserved is a merge fix, only genuinely unwritten is a re-ingest.

designUnderReview.writtenLayer: Per (entity_type, county) atom counts from hauska_mcp.atoms, index-only via atoms_entity_composite_unique, ONE entity type at a time, strictly serialized. Plus a suffix-structure pass per family so an atom count is never silently read as a parcel count.
designUnderReview.scoredLayer: cortex neondb county_facet_coverage x county_rail x county_manifest, and the LIVE GET /api/county-ledger response, each figure carrying its own computedAt.
designUnderReview.servedLayer: The SS-W5 instrument (merged to main at d455c82) run statewide as a background job with a registered watch. It is the only thing here that costs hours.
designUnderReview.output: StatewideServingSweep (frozen record, unchanged) PLUS an additive top-level threeLayer field, so lane SS-W7's GET /api/serving-sweep serves it without a second shape.

adversarialReview.risk: The county key is a RECONSTRUCTION. split_part(entity_id,':',1) assumes a fips prefix, and the standing rule is that entityId shapes are NOT uniform across writers.
adversarialReview.state: PARTIALLY MITIGATED, one check still owed
adversarialReview.mitigation: First and last entity_id sampled for all 17 entity types at source: the 15 property families are all '48xxx:' prefixed; code-section and code-cross-reference are jurisdiction-slug keyed and are NOT county rails. OWED BEFORE THE NUMBER IS TRUSTED: a divergence test on parcel-node comparing split_part(entity_id,':',1) against body->>'countyFips' (a partial index exists for exactly that expression). If they disagree, the prefix derivation is wrong for at least one writer and every WRITTEN figure is suspect.

adversarialReview.risk: 'Counties with at least one atom' is a PRESENCE test wearing a coverage test's clothes. A county with 3 footprint atoms would count identically to one with 300,000.
adversarialReview.mitigation: Every WRITTEN figure carries both the county count AND the atom count AND the parcel-roster denominator for that county. Presence and depth are reported as two different numbers and never collapsed.

adversarialReview.risk: Classifying unwritten vs written-unscored against a ledger materialized 2026-08-14T17:41:22.500Z, which is 4.8 days stale and staler than the work it describes.
adversarialReview.state: MITIGATED, AND IT IS THE POINT
adversarialReview.mitigation: WRITTEN is measured live by this lane; SCORED travels with its computedAt everywhere it appears. The stale-vs-live comparison IS the finding, not a contaminant.

adversarialReview.risk: The SERVED sweep over ~13.4M parcels will not finish inside one session, and a partial run could be reported as if statewide.
adversarialReview.mitigation: Background job, progress artifact registered in _catalog/watch_registry.json BEFORE start (id ss-w9-statewide-audit, 30 min quiet budget). The SERVED layer is reported with the exact county and parcel denominator swept AT REPORT TIME, and marked not-measured elsewhere. not-measured is a stated class, never an inferred zero.

adversarialReview.risk: Scoring every rail against 254 manufactures holes that do not exist (the standing rrc-wells finding: its source is a Harris-only mirror, reachable ceiling 1 county).
adversarialReview.mitigation: railCapabilities is read LIVE off /api/county-ledger and every rail carries its ceiling and the ceiling's basis. Cells above the ceiling classify out-of-reach, which is explicitly NOT a gap.

adversarialReview.risk: The gap classifier's zeros could be dead gates, which is the defect class this programme exists to hunt.
adversarialReview.mitigation: A test that proves EVERY GapClass value can fire on constructed input, plus a divergence test that mutates one input and asserts the class moves. A classifier that cannot be shown to produce a class must not be trusted to report its absence.

adversarialReview.risk: Reporting another lane's magnitudes as this lane's findings.
adversarialReview.mitigation: Every figure in the report is labelled VERIFIED (run by this lane at source), INFERRED, or RELAYED. SS-W5's two-county tallies are RELAYED unless re-run here.

preRegisteredExpectations: footprint: WRITTEN in roughly 174 counties (L26 close 2026-08-17), SCORED not-yet on 254 of 254. A result outside that is a finding either way.
rrc-wells: WRITTEN in far MORE than 1 county despite a stated capability ceiling of 1 county. If true, either the ceiling or the write is wrong, and that contradiction is a free finding.

At least one rail will be written-unscored with no scorer to run at all, i.e. a recompute of the ledger would NOT move it. That is a materially more expensive class than the dispatch's staleness framing and must be reported as its own thing.
constraintsHonored: Read-only against both production databases: no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL issued.
No atoms bulk-writer slot taken, no lease, no --apply.
Heavy scans serialized: one entity type at a time inside one script, never two in parallel.
Watch registered in _catalog/watch_registry.json before the first long scan started.
Isolated worktree; nothing merged, deployed, or pushed to main.
openAtCp1: parcel-node prefix-vs-body countyFips divergence test not yet run
SERVED statewide job not yet started
